grammar.pattern: 不知道 / 想问 + 疑问分句
grammar.purpose: Retrieve indirect questions without asserting an answer
grammar.explanation: 我不知道她指谁 embeds the unknown reference. It does not assert that she refers to a specific person. Unlike a direct question, an indirect unknown can occur inside a statement; do not add 吗 mechanically.

examples.py: wǒ bù zhī dào tā zhǐ shéi .
examples.en: I do not know whom she refers to.

examples.zh: 我想问这个模型是谁造的。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn zhè gè mó xíng shì shéi zào de .
examples.en: I want to ask who made this model.

examples.zh: 她还没说什么时候转变的。
examples.py: tā hái méi shuō shén me shí hou zhuǎn biàn de .
examples.en: She has not said when the change happened.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不知道她指谁，所以一定指老师。
commonMistakes.right: 我不知道她指谁，还要问。
commonMistakes.why: An unknown reference does not identify someone.

grammar.pattern: 看得懂 / 看不懂：字幕再应用
grammar.explanation: 这句看得懂 indicates potential understanding of that sentence, not a claim about every line. 看不清 concerns visual clarity; 看不懂 concerns meaning. A replay may improve clarity without guaranteeing understanding.

examples.zh: 这句看得懂，下一句还不懂。
examples.py: zhè jù kàn dé dǒng , xià yī jù hái bù dǒng .
examples.en: I understand this sentence, but not the next.

examples.py: zì tài xiǎo , wǒ kàn bù qīng .
examples.en: The text is too small to see clearly.

examples.zh: 声音调低了，这句还听得清。
examples.py: shēng yīn tiáo dī le , zhè jù hái tīng dé qīng .
examples.en: The sound is lowered but this sentence is still audible clearly.

commonMistakes.right: 听得清还不一定理解全部意思。

dialogue.title: The source of 她
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 她说她会改，这两个她是同一个人吗？
lines.py: tā shuō tā huì gǎi , zhè liǎng gè tā shì tóng yī gè rén ma ?
lines.en: She says she will change it. Are both 她 the same person?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这一段还没说明。我专门来问，不随便猜。
lines.py: zhè yī duàn hái méi shuō míng . wǒ zhuān mén lái wèn , bù suí biàn cāi .
lines.en: This passage has not specified it. I came specifically to ask instead of guessing.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 把声音调低，字切换成大一点，能看得懂吗？
lines.py: bǎ shēng yīn tiáo dī , zì qiè huàn chéng dà yī diǎn , néng kàn dé dǒng ma ?
lines.en: Lower the sound and switch to larger text. Can you understand it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 字看得清，但意思还不全懂。老师指导我们查前一句。
lines.py: zì kàn dé qīng , dàn yì si hái bù quán dǒng . lǎo shī zhǐ dǎo wǒ men chá qián yī jù .
lines.en: The words are clear, but meaning is incomplete. The teacher guides us to check the previous sentence.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她指出旧地址造成误会，应当改；已经改了吗？
lines.py: tā zhǐ chū jiù dì zhǐ zào chéng wù huì , yīng dāng gǎi ; yǐ jīng gǎi le ma ?
lines.en: She points out the old address caused misunderstanding and should change. Is it changed?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还没。形成方案和实行不同，总结只写完成部分。
lines.py: hái méi . xíng chéng fāng àn hé shí xíng bù tóng , zǒng jié zhǐ xiě wán chéng bù fèn .
lines.en: Not yet. Forming a plan differs from implementing it; summarize completed parts only.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Yes, every plan has been implemented

reading.title: Look back before deciding
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 提问先说明专题，关注实际回答；这句指谁，需要上下文。
lines.py: tí wèn xiān shuō míng zhuān tí , guān zhù shí jì huí dá ; zhè jù zhǐ shéi , xū yào shàng xià wén .
lines.en: State the topic when asking and attend to the answer; the reference needs context.

lines.zh: 把牌子转过来，形状像环的模型是纸造的，不是铁。
lines.py: bǎ pái zi zhuǎn guò lái , xíng zhuàng xiàng huán de mó xíng shì zhǐ zào de , bù shì tiě .
lines.en: Turn the sign around; the ring-shaped model is paper, not iron.

lines.zh: 线断了也保留本地记录；调整音量不是换说话人，切换字幕不是完成理解。
lines.py: xiàn duàn le yě bǎo liú běn dì jì lù ; tiáo zhěng yīn liàng bù shì huàn shuō huà rén , qiè huàn zì mù bù shì wán chéng lǐ jiě .
lines.en: Retain local records after connection loss; volume adjustment does not change speakers; changing captions does not complete understanding.

lines.zh: 打破安静使她开始提问，想法转变的原因仍没说。一切只指本段安排。
lines.py: dǎ pò ān jìng shǐ tā kāi shǐ tí wèn , xiǎng fǎ zhuǎn biàn de yuán yīn réng méi shuō . yī qiè zhǐ zhǐ běn duàn ān pái .
lines.en: Breaking silence makes her start asking; the reason her view changes remains unstated; everything refers only to this passage’s arrangements.

lines.zh: 抓住一句、追问前一句可以查指代；武器台词是虚构场景，不教真实使用。
lines.py: zhuā zhù yī jù , zhuī wèn qián yī jù kě yǐ chá zhǐ dài ; wǔ qì tái cí shì xū gòu chǎng jǐng , bù jiào zhēn shí shǐ yòng .
lines.en: Holding onto a line and asking about the preceding line may clarify reference; weapon dialogue is fictional, not usage instruction.
